children.value: > Fact From Story: Melkisethian says his sales actually grew during the pandemic in spite of the fact that his brick-and-mortar sales disappeared.

> > Fact From Story: The pandemic had created something of a record sales bubble: people who were already vinyl aficionados were stuck at home with their record players, stimulus checks, and nothing to spend them on besides survival and things you could do at home — like listen to music.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If people are stuck at home, they are more likely to buy things that they can use at home.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Sales increase when more people buy something.
